title: slugify() keeps punctuation
prompt: slugify() in src/slug.js keeps punctuation in slugs ("Hello, World!" should become "hello-world"). Fix it and make sure the tests pass.
note: Designed fork/rerun disagreement. With a task-runner rule the toy agent first runs the setup that AGENTS.md documents (`make setup`, step 1), before the fork point. A lazy fork (lenient system prompt, live from the first npm call) replays the vanilla steps 1-3, so setup never happens and `make test` fails: the fork fails while full reruns pass. This is why the gate also runs tier-3 reruns.
